entities.summary: Roi Klein (Hebrew: רועי קליין; IPA: [ʁoˈʕi klain]; was an Israeli major in the Golani Brigade of the Israeli Defense Forces who died during the 2006 Lebanon War. Klein was killed in the Battle of Bint Jbeil after jumping on a grenade to save his fellow soldiers.
